title: At least one in four former NFL players in study suffered from degenerative brain disease CTE

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: At least one in four former NFL players in study suffered from degenerative brain disease CTE
sources.description: At least one in four former NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 was found to have had chronic ⁠traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), according to a study released on Tuesday. Out of the 878 former players who died during that time frame, 235 donated their brains for study, researchers said, with 215 ⁠of those donated brains ⁠found to have CTE, ​a degenerative disease that can only definitively be diagnosed after death. CTE is associated with repeated blows to the head, including concussions.
